citing_sentence: Statin therapy reduced major vascular events by 21% per mmol/L LDL reduction.
cited_abstract: We report a meta-analysis of statin trials showing a 21% proportional reduction in major vascular events per mmol/L LDL cholesterol reduction.

f5_candidates.title: Updated meta-analysis revises the per-mmol/L effect downward
f5_candidates.abstract: A larger pooled analysis finds a 14% reduction per mmol/L, revising the earlier 21% estimate.
